item.title: Controlled scarcity: MP Materials builds America's rare earth answer while China keeps the heavies at home
item.summary: MP Materials' second quarter is best read as a status report on an industrial contest. On the one hand, China has tightened its grip on the parts of the rare earth chain that matter most for defense and high-performance motors. On the other hand, the US is paying to stand up a parallel supply chain inside a single company.
